title: Marbled's Melees 2D!
body:
I always wanted Marbled's Melees in 2D, and it still has not happened yet.

Current textures not updatedd to 2D yet:
- Tomahawk
- Pipe Wrench
- Bone Saw
- Machete
- Stop Sign

All textures were created by me, except the Fire Axe and crowbar -- which were shamefully stolen from the mod icon -- and were insipred by these textures.

BTW unofficial if you thought it was.
